description: Ex-Luftwaffe RF-84F Thunderflash reconnaissance fighter in early Bundeswehr markings EB+250, gate guardian at the eastern entrance of Fliegerhorst Schleswig. Aufklärungsgeschwader 52 flew the type from Jagel.
F-104G Starfighter gate guardian at Fliegerhorst Schleswig, displayed wearing the false code 23+81. The Starfighter served the reconnaissance wing at Jagel in the RF-104G role.
Panavia Tornado IDS gate guardian at Fliegerhorst Schleswig, home of the Tornado reconnaissance force (Taktisches Luftwaffengeschwader 51 Immelmann).
Ex-Luftwaffe Lockheed T-33A jet trainer, gate guardian at the southern entrance of Fliegerhorst Schleswig.
aliases: T33A; T-33A; Shooting Star; T-Bird; T33
